PKFloatRange.doc: A utility class that represents range components of a stroke.

PKToolPickerEraserItem.doc: An item that represents an eraser tool in the tool picker.

PKToolPickerInkingItem.doc: An item that represents an inking tool in the tool picker.

PKToolPickerItem.doc: The base class for an item in the tool picker.

PKContentVersion.doc: Constants that represent versions of PencilKit for backward compatibility.

PKContentVersion1.doc: The PencilKit version that supports inks from iPadOS 14 and earlier, including marker, pen, and pencil.

PKContentVersion2.doc: The PencilKit version that supports inks from iPadOS 17 and earlier, including marker, pen, pencil, monoline, fountain pen, watercolor, and crayon.

PKContentVersion3.doc: The PencilKit version that supports barrel-roll angle data in inks.

PKContentVersion4.doc: The version that adds the Reed Pen ink.

PKContentVersion5.doc: The version that adds stroke render state support.

PKContentVersionLatest.doc: A property that returns latest version of PencilKit, which supports all currently available inks.

PKEraserType.doc: Constants that indicate the behavior of the eraser.

PKEraserTypeBitmap.doc: An eraser that removes only those portions of the drawing it touches.

PKEraserTypeVector.doc: An eraser that removes an entire drawn line.

-initWithLowerBound:upperBound:.doc: A utility class used to contain ranges returned by the PKStroke API.

-initWithEraserType:width:.doc: Creates a new eraser item with the specified width.

-initWithInkType:.doc: Create a new tool picker item with a PKInkType.

-initWithInkType:color:width:.doc: Creates a new inking item with the specified ink type, color, and width.

-initWithInkType:color:width:identifier:.doc: Creates a new inking item with the specified ink type, color, width, and identifier.

-initWithInkType:width:.doc: Create a new tool picker item with a PKInkType.

lowerBound.doc: A floating point value that represents the lower bound of the range.

upperBound.doc: A floating point value that represents the upper bound of the range.

eraserTool.doc: An eraser tool for erasing parts of a drawing.

init(type:width:).doc: Creates a new eraser item with the specified width.

allowsColorSelection.doc: Present color selection UI to the user. Default value is YES.

init(type:color:width:azimuth:identifier.doc: Create a new inking tool item.

init(type:color:width:identifier:).doc: Create a new inking tool item.

inkingTool.doc: A tool for drawing on a canvas view.

identifier.doc: A string that identifies the item in the tool picker.

tool.doc: The PKTool this tool picker item represents.
